sentences.text: In a mouse model of inflammation-induced depression, researchers administered 0.83 mg/kg of lipopolysaccharide to trigger an inflammatory response, followed thirty minutes later by an injection of 5 mL/kg of hydrogen-rich saline.
This treatment reduced signs of anxiety and depression, as measured by behavioral assessments including the open field, elevated plus maze, forced swim, and tail suspension tests.

Biological analyses showed that the intervention lowered blood levels of the inflammatory markers interleukin-1β and tumor necrosis factor-α, reduced the number of activated microglia cells, and inhibited the TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB signaling pathway in the brain.
Additionally, the study observed that synaptic damage in the hippocampus was repaired following the administration of the saline solution.
The authors conclude that early administration of hydrogen-rich saline may reduce inflammation-related depression-like behaviors in this animal model.
